data.name: Benedita
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Benedita means 'the Lord has blessed'. It is a name derived from the Hebrew root word 'Benedic', which means 'to bless'. Benedita is often associated with the biblical figure of Hannah, who was barren and prayed to God for a child. When she gave birth to her son, she named him Samuel, which means 'asked of God', and thanked the Lord for blessing her with a son. Benedita is a name that celebrates the blessings and graces bestowed upon us by God.
